description: Run the FERS FEM solver on a structural model. Input is the full model JSON (as a string). Returns displacements, internal forces and reactions. Runs on this machine; nothing is metered. Results are returned at `detail: standard` by default — ask for 'summary' when you only need peak values, and 'full' only when you genuinely need every sample point.

detail.description: How much result data to return. 'summary' (peak forces, displacements and reactions with where they occur — smallest, usually enough), 'standard' (default: envelopes + node displacements + reactions), or 'full' (adds section forces and the complete internal-force series; can be hundreds of thousands of tokens on a real model).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying a solve so the retry is recognised as the same request.

include_report.description: Embed the rendered HTML hand-calc report in the response. Default false — it is large. Use the free render_report tool on a saved result instead.

model.description: Stringified JSON of the FERS structural model

model_ref.description: Handle from stash_model, used INSTEAD of `model`. Avoids sending the whole document on every step; the tool returns the same handle back.

result_filter.description: Advanced: emit only these result blocks, overriding `detail`. Any of: local_envelopes, global_envelopes, local_end_forces, global_end_forces, section_forces, internal_force_series, local_displacements, node_displacements, reactions. An empty list is a maximal strip. Unity checks, summaries and diagnostics are never filtered.

name: solve_model
title: Solve a structural model
